audit_findings.title: FY2025 owner earnings do not reflect the June 2026 debt burden
audit_findings.magnitude: $595.579 million debt increase; approximately $27.7 million annual pre-tax interest at June 2026 rates
audit_findings.mechanism: Equity-level owner earnings retain interest expense, so a persistent increase in floating-rate debt reduces prospective OE rather than being deducted as debt principal in the bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: Interest and other income/expense, net was $72.5 million, primarily consisting of $63.1 million of interest expense, which decreased $22.8 million compared to the prior year due to a lower average debt balance and lower variable interest rates.
audit_findings.explanation: The timing mismatch is demonstrated: debt rose from $1.089438 billion to $1.685017 billion. Applying the filed June rates to the $325.0 million revolver increase and $270.109 million securitization increase produces about $27.7 million of annual pre-tax interest, equal to 4.5% of the $610.1 million anchor. Even a conservative proportional reduction would lower the base value by only about $3.16 per share and cannot close the $68.64 gap between the $147.64 price and the $79.00 bull value. It therefore does not change the valuation conclusion, although the forecast should still be corrected.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the $595.0 million of net 2026 borrowings to the filed $432.183 million of repurchases, $78.948 million acquisition spending, and working-capital funding; then rerun OE using interest on the debt expected to remain outstanding.

audit_findings.title: Growth is valued without its disclosed working-capital funding requirement
audit_findings.magnitude: $269.929 million first-half 2026 core freight working-capital use, equal to 44.2% of the $610.1 million anchor
audit_findings.mechanism: Incremental receivables and contract assets required for growth consume cash but are not deducted from scenario OE; required operating liquidity may also make part of the $154.59 million cash bridge addition unavailable.
audit_findings.evidence: As our volumes increase or we increase freight rates charged to our customers, the resulting increase in revenues may increase our working capital needs due to our business model, which generally has a higher length of days sales outstanding than days payables outstanding.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated construction omission, while the sustainable annual amount remains unresolved. During the first half of 2026, the $704.333 million receivables outflow and $74.457 million contract-asset outflow exceeded the $441.310 million accounts-payable/outstanding-check inflow and $67.551 million accrued-transportation inflow by $269.929 million. The filing attributes the operating-cash-flow decline to increased net operating working capital as pricing and costs rose. That observed amount is large relative to anchor OE and shows that mechanically growing OE by 3% to 5% without a reinvestment charge can materially overstate distributable cash.
audit_findings.action: Calculate normalized incremental operating working capital per dollar of revenue and adjusted gross profit across a full freight cycle, deduct it in every growth scenario, determine minimum operating cash, and rerun the cash bridge using only verified excess cash.

audit_findings.title: The trend anchor mixes sold-business history with the current perimeter
audit_findings.magnitude: $61.190 million of 2024 and $73.977 million of 2023 disposed-business adjusted gross profit; $44.5 million 2024 pre-tax disposal loss and $2.1 million 2025 transaction-related expense
audit_findings.mechanism: The ten-year OE trend includes earnings from a business no longer owned and disposal-related charges that do not represent current continuing operations, affecting the anchor in opposite directions.
audit_findings.evidence: We determined the divestiture did not represent a strategic shift that would have a major effect on our consolidated results of operations, and therefore the results of our Europe Surface Transportation business are not reported as discontinued operations.
audit_findings.explanation: The perimeter mismatch is demonstrated, but its net effect on the $610.1 million trend anchor cannot be established from the supplied segment gross-profit and disposal-cost disclosures. Removing the disposed operation's historical contribution would reduce OE, while removing the $44.5 million disposal loss and $2.1 million of 2025 transaction-related expense would increase it. Older continuing-business OE and attributable taxes, capital expenditure, and noncash charges are not supplied, so materiality remains unresolved.
audit_findings.action: Reconstruct each historical OE year on the post-February-2025 perimeter, separately reverse the filed disposal and transaction costs, and rerun the log-trend anchor and all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: The anchor may capitalize an unusually favorable 2025 tax rate
audit_findings.magnitude: $31.818 million FY2025 share-based-payment tax benefit, equal to 5.2% of the $610.1 million anchor
audit_findings.mechanism: A non-durable tax benefit raises reported net income and OE; including it in the historical series can raise the trend anchor and every forecast cash flow derived from that anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: The lower rate was driven by higher foreign tax credits, higher tax benefits from share-based compensation, and the prior year impact of the divestiture of our European Surface Transportation business, partially offset by a reduced benefit from U.S. tax credits in the current year and non-recurring discrete items in the prior year.
audit_findings.explanation: The $31.818 million FY2025 benefit is filed and identifiable, but treating it as nonrecurring is not yet established. Share-award tax benefits continued in 2026 and reduced the first-half effective rate by 9.1 percentage points, demonstrating volatility rather than proving that the benefit will disappear. The direct FY2025 amount is meaningful relative to anchor OE, but the effect on the ten-year log-trend anchor is unquantified without a tax-normalized rerun.
audit_findings.action: Build a sustainable cash-tax rate excluding excess share-award deductions, divestiture effects, discrete items, and non-durable credits; restate the historical OE series consistently and rerun the trend anchor and scenarios.
